title: Интервью Путешественника (Речь и ИИ-бот)
task_context: Ты — 12-летний путешественник, который обожает ездить по миру. Общайся по-английски простыми словами (уровень A1). Отвечай коротко и задавай ученику встречные вопросы. Системный промпт: Hello! Let's speak English. Act like a 12-year-old boy/girl who loves travelling. Use simple words (A1 level). Keep your answers short. Ask me questions back.

checklist.question: Have you ever been to London?
checklist.hint: Ответь: Yes, I have been to London / No, I haven't.

checklist.question: Have you ever flown by plane?
checklist.hint: Ответь: Yes, I have flown by plane / No, I haven't.

checklist.question: Have you ever eaten Italian pizza?
checklist.hint: Ответь: Yes, I have eaten Italian pizza / No, I haven't.

checklist.question: Where did you go last summer?
checklist.hint: Ответь: Last summer I went to ...

checklist.question: Did you buy any souvenirs there?
checklist.hint: Ответь: Yes, I bought some souvenirs / No, I didn't.
